name: business-layer-architecture
title: 按业务逻辑分层的架构收敛
description: 按领域模型、应用服务、基础设施与接口适配、前端呈现和交付验证分层收敛 Leanote，保持外部 API、USN、所有权和数据语义兼容。
creator: wanfeng
notes: 2026-09-13 ownership correction: application-notes owns note-specific asset receipt/idempotency adapters; application-content owns generic file-root/path/publish/verify/download/album/PDF primitives; Suggestion/feedback belongs to application-admin. Pure application contracts stay free of app/db/BSON, while the existing app/service -> app/db compatibility boundary and internal BSON maps remain allowed; controllers must not hold Mongo collection/client or duplicate business state machines. Cross-topology/browser/PDF/failpoint evidence stays with receiving siblings and does not create a reverse dependency.
